args: $projectServer = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 24225 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $projectServer) { Start-Process -FilePath 'uv' -ArgumentList @('run','--with','serena-agent','serena','start-project-server') -WindowStyle Hidden | Out-Null; for ($attempt = 0; $attempt -lt 30; $attempt++) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; $projectServer = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 24225 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($projectServer) { break } }; if (-not $projectServer) { throw 'Serena ProjectServer did not start on port 24225' } }; & uv run --with serena-agent serena start-mcp-server --context vscode --add-mode query-projects --project C:\Users\hiner\code\fiji\fiji-llm

. "$HOME/.local/bin/env"; uv_path="$(command -v uv || true)"; if [[ -z "$uv_path" ]]; then echo 'uv was not found on PATH' >&2; exit 1; fi; if ! /usr/sbin/lsof -nP -iTCP:24225 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$uv_path" run --with serena-agent serena start-project-server >/tmp/serena-project-server.log 2>&1 & for attempt in {1..30}; do if /usr/sbin/lsof -nP -iTCP:24225 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; if ! /usr/sbin/lsof -nP -iTCP:24225 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Serena ProjectServer did not start on port 24225; see /tmp/serena-project-server.log' >&2; exit 1; fi; fi; exec "$uv_path" run --with serena-agent serena start-mcp-server --context vscode --add-mode query-projects --project /Users/hiner/code/fiji/fiji-llm
